ops.en: to decode a cipher or coded text, or to make sense of difficult, unclear, or hard-to-read writing, speech, or information
ops.cn: 破译密码；辨认、理解难懂或难读的文字、言语或信息

ops.en: old and in very poor condition through age, wear, or neglect, of a person, building, vehicle, system, or other thing
ops.cn: 年久失修的；衰老破败的；因年久、磨损或疏于维护而状况很差的

ops.en: to damage someone's reputation by making false, malicious, or damaging statements about them
ops.cn: 诽谤；通过虚假、恶意或有损名誉的言论损害他人声誉

ops.en: open resistance or refusal to obey authority, rules, commands, or an opposing force
ops.cn: 公然反抗、违抗权威、规则、命令或对抗力量

ops.en: an act of openly resisting or refusing to obey
ops.cn: 公然反抗、违抗的行为

Contemptuous attitude can accompany defiance but is not definitional.

ops.meaning_cn: 缺乏某物；在某方面不足

ops.en: to illegally or deceitfully obtain money or property from someone, or deprive them of it
ops.cn: 诈骗；以欺骗手段非法获取或使某人失去钱财

ops.meaning_cn: 骗取某人的某物；诈骗某人的钱财

ops.en: skillful, quick, and effective in movement or in handling a task or situation, especially with the hands
ops.cn: 熟练灵巧的；动作或处理事情快速而有效的

ops.cn: 使脱水；除去水分；失去过多体液而脱水

ops.note: Food-preservation use by removing water is a specific application.

ops.meaning_cn: 屈尊做某事；做自己认为有失身份的事

ops.en: harmful or damaging, especially to health, living systems, the environment, or another process or condition
ops.cn: 有害的；造成损害的；尤指对健康、生态或其他系统不利的

ops.en: to describe or portray something precisely, or clearly indicate its features, roles, limits, or boundaries
ops.cn: 清楚描述、界定；明确指出特征、角色或边界

ops.note: Literal tracing or outlining of a shape is a narrower branch.

ops.en: to make someone believe something false, or to deceive oneself about reality
ops.cn: 欺骗；使某人相信错误之事；自欺

ops.meaning_cn: 欺骗某人使其相信某事

ops.en: a severe flood, or figuratively an overwhelming quantity of something arriving at once
ops.cn: 洪水；大量涌来的事物

ops.cn: 淹没；使充斥大量事物

ops.meaning_cn: 用大量……淹没、轰炸某人/某物

ops.en: the death of a person, or the end, failure, or disappearance of something
ops.cn: 死亡；终结；失败或消亡

ops.note: Legal/historical verb meaning transfer by lease or will is specialist.

ops.en: to raise an objection, express reluctance, or hesitate to agree or comply
ops.cn: 提出异议；表示迟疑或不情愿

ops.en: an objection, hesitation, or expression of reluctance
ops.cn: 异议；迟疑；不情愿

ops.note: Enter a demurrer is specialist legal use.

ops.en: shockingly bad, unacceptable, or deserving strong condemnation
ops.cn: 糟糕透顶的；令人无法接受、应受严厉谴责的

ops.en: in very poor condition or of very poor quality
ops.cn: 状况极差的；质量很差的

ops.en: to remove a ruler, leader, or office-holder from power or office
ops.cn: 罢免；废黜；使统治者或官员下台

ops.cn: （法律/正式）宣誓作证；录取证词

ops.en: abandoned or in very poor condition through neglect
ops.cn: 废弃失修的；因疏于维护而破败的

ops.en: neglectful of one's duty or responsibility
ops.cn: 玩忽职守的；未尽职责的

ops.en: dated and disparaging: a homeless or destitute person
ops.cn: （旧式且贬义）无家可归或赤贫的人

ops.en: expressing contempt, mockery, or ridicule
ops.cn: 嘲讽的；讥笑的；表示轻蔑的

ops.en: old-fashioned or literary: scheming and crafty in pursuing one's own interests
ops.cn: （旧式/文学）工于心计的；为自身利益精心算计的

ops.cn: （旧式/文学）工于心计、为自身利益精心算计的

ops.en: to plunder or rob a place or person of possessions or resources
ops.cn: 掠夺；抢劫财物或资源

ops.en: to strip a place, person, or environment of possessions, resources, beauty, or value
ops.cn: 剥夺；掠去某地、某人或环境的资源、美感或价值

ops.en: certain, likely, intended, or expected to happen, become something, or reach a particular outcome
ops.cn: 注定的；很可能或预定会发生、成为某种状态的

ops.en: emotionally uninvolved, objective, or remote from other people or events
ops.cn: 超然的；客观冷静的；感情上疏离的

Detached building/house stands separately from others.

ops.en: separation or disconnection, or a state of emotional distance, objectivity, or lack of involvement
ops.cn: 分离；脱离；也指情感上的超然、客观或疏离

ops.note: Military detachment = a small unit assigned to a particular task.

ops.en: to reduce the value, quality, importance, or attractiveness of something
ops.cn: 减损；降低价值、质量、重要性或吸引力

ops.meaning_cn: 有损于；降低……的价值或质量

ops.en: to severely destroy or damage a place, system, community, or resource, or to emotionally shock and distress someone
ops.cn: 严重破坏、摧毁；使某人极度震惊或悲痛

ops.en: completely lacking or free from something
ops.cn: 完全缺乏……的；没有……的

ops.en: deep love, loyalty, or committed dedication to a person, cause, activity, purpose, or duty
ops.cn: 深厚的爱、忠诚或对人、事业、活动、目标或职责的投入

ops.cn: 对事业、目标、活动或职责的投入和奉献

ops.en: deep love, loyalty, or affection toward a person or thing
ops.cn: 深厚的爱、忠诚或依恋

ops.note: Religious devotions are prayers or acts of worship.

ops.en: a ruler who holds absolute or largely unrestricted political power
ops.cn: 独裁者；拥有绝对或基本不受限制政治权力的统治者

ops.note: Rare noun for a person or device that dictates text is secondary.
